_help: World map window in 1366x768 space. wx,wy,ww,wh is the window; worldX/worldY the map art inside it (the picture's own top left corner, 640x470); titleH is the title strip height. The left column: infoX/infoY is the header box (168x59, the map name goes here), infoBodyY the body box under it (168x344); nameX/nameY/nameW the map name inside the header; lifeX/lifeY/lifeStep/lifeRows the NPC and monster rows (the official lifeLT is 16,145 with a 20 px pitch); teleportX/teleportY and naviStartX/naviStartY the two disabled buttons under the list. The toolbar: btnY, btnW/btnH, upperX/locateX/searchX/bookmarkX/naviX are the five buttons on the title strip (the art is 37x25). The top strip: comboX/comboY/comboW/comboPitch place the three combo boxes. A map node's click box is its icon size, so it has no key here. The search panel hangs on the right edge: searchW/searchH, then sInX/sInY/sInW/sInH the name field, goInset/goSize the search button inside the field's right end, sTypeX/sTypeY/sTypeW its combo, sCloseX/sCloseY its X, and sListX/sListY/sRowW/sRowH/sRows the result rows. The confirm dialog: confirmW/confirmH (the sysPop art is 318 wide), popBottomH the bottom bar, popTextY/popTextStep the two lines, popYesX/popNoX/popBtnY and popBtnW/popBtnH the two buttons. wcloseX/wcloseY the window X. The minimap window has its own file (panel-minimap.json).
